label: Bible Study
prompt: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a _____ of fools shall be destroyed.
verse: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
note: Choose your company carefully — wisdom and folly are both contagious.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: As one whom his _____ comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
verse: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
note: As a mother comforts her child — one of the Bible's tenderest pictures of God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And let fall also some of the _____ of purpose for her, and leave them, that she may glean them, and rebuke her not.
verse: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them, that she may glean them, and rebuke her not.
note: Boaz told his reapers to drop extra handfuls 'of purpose' for Ruth — kindness disguised as carelessness.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the LORD, which hath not left thee this day without a _____, that his name may be famous in Israel.
verse: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the LORD, which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel.
note: The kinsman-redeemer was the relative who bought back family land — Boaz did, and Naomi got a grandson.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is _____; but be filled with the Spirit;
verse: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
note: Paul's contrast: don't be filled with wine, which leads to 'excess' — be filled with the Spirit instead.
